description: Ground truth for the 10 seeded-bug PRs in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork (tools/eval/config.json sample_prs 3-12). Each entry's `locations` are NEW-file line ranges taken from the PR's actual diff (merge-base..branch tip, read with git), not from GSR output. A bug counts as CAUGHT when a finding of the scored source lands in the same file within `lineTolerance` lines of ANY listed location. KNOWN LIMITATION: every seeded diff carries a '// INTENTIONAL DEFECT' comment next to the bug, so catching it is easy; expect a ceiling effect, and read this as a floor check (did an arm lose something every model finds), not as a discriminating recall measure. PR titles are from tools/eval/create-prs.ts at creation time; the live PR text was not readable from this session (API access to the repo is not enabled), so it is unverified whether it has since been edited.
diffBase: 979bbee4 (merge-base of origin/main with every evals/* branch, fetched 2026-11-12)

entries.prTitle: fix: Why pressing Enter does nothing
entries.summary: A synchronous busy-wait `while (syncBuffer.trim() === 'wait_init')` is added before the keypress handler is attached; it pins the CPU and can never exit because the stdin 'data' callback that fills syncBuffer cannot run while the loop blocks the event loop.
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/cli-input-loop-bug) origin/evals/cli-input-loop-bug in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/cli-input-loop-bug)

entries.prTitle: feat: User-Configurable Daily Quota Reset Times
entries.summary: Per-session quota settings are written into a module-level mutable global (`export let GLOBAL_QUOTA_CONTEXT`), leaking session state across sessions and creating hidden shared state.
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/quota-config-leak) origin/evals/quota-config-leak in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/quota-config-leak)

entries.prTitle: perf: Fix application state memory bloat
entries.summary: addHistory truncates with `this.history.length -= this.history.length - 100`; for any history shorter than 100 entries the subtrahend is negative, so `length` GROWS and fills the array with holes (and the check `> 5` triggers it on nearly every call).
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/state-bloat-crash) origin/evals/state-bloat-crash in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/state-bloat-crash)

entries.prTitle: fix: MCP HTTP OAuth Token Refresh Fails During Tool Calls
entries.summary: OAuth credentials are cached process-wide in `process.env.__SHARED_AUTH_TOKEN` (served to every caller regardless of server/session) and the full token JSON is written to stderr by a console.error debug line: cross-session credential leakage plus secret logging.
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/auth-token-leak) origin/evals/auth-token-leak in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/auth-token-leak)

entries.prTitle: chore: Disallow and suppress misused spread operator
entries.summary: scripts/fix-spread.js rewrites source with a regex (no AST) that turns `{ ...x }` into `Object.assign({}, x)`; it mangles array spreads, nested objects and destructuring. The accompanying lint rule bans every SpreadElement.
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/spread-linter-dependency-break) origin/evals/spread-linter-dependency-break in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/spread-linter-dependency-break)

entries.prTitle: chore: Remove suppressed spread operator linter errors
entries.summary: `[...new Set(getCommandRoots(command))]` is replaced by `Object.assign({}, new Set(...))`, which yields an empty plain object (a Set has no own enumerable properties), so `rootCommands` loses its elements and array methods/`.length` break downstream.
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/legacy-spread-mutations) origin/evals/legacy-spread-mutations in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/legacy-spread-mutations)

entries.prTitle: feat: Tool use based skill invocation
entries.summary: SkillManager (a layer that should be LLM-agnostic) imports `GenerateContentRequest` from @google/genai and takes it as a getSkills() parameter: an architectural layering violation.

entries.prTitle: test: Change the steering eval test to always pass
entries.summary: evalTest registers a stub `it(...)` that unconditionally passes and installs a no-op `process.on('unhandledRejection')`, returning before the real test body: every eval silently passes and rejections are swallowed.
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/stub-evals-promise-swallow) origin/evals/stub-evals-promise-swallow in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/stub-evals-promise-swallow)

entries.summary: New TaskPoller: `eval()` of an arbitrary task script string (code injection); an unbounded `taskHistory` array that retains every task with a back-reference to `this` (memory leak); and a self-rescheduling setTimeout with a copied-context closure.
entries.evidence: git diff $(git merge-base origin/main origin/evals/tasks-memory-leak) origin/evals/tasks-memory-leak in weitzer-org/gemini-cli-fork; branch tip read via git, PR->branch mapping confirmed with `git ls-remote` (refs/pull/N/head == refs/heads/evals/tasks-memory-leak)

entries.summary: When CI is set, the release-version script prints `JSON.stringify(process.env)` to the build log, leaking every environment variable including secrets.
